title: Explicit PAH generator locality replay for the geometric incidence successor
purpose: Recompute the actual PAH midpoint generator rows on the anchor interaction patch of G_n and verify exact equality between levels n=1 and n=2 for every finite Q=0 local state. This sidecar adds no model term, move, parameter or projection.

exact_scope.carrier_family: The PAH-OMC-004 anchored two-row strip G_n with q_i split for i<n and frontier square q_n.
exact_scope.state: All four patch apertures j in {0,1} and all five patch Z_2 links in {0,1}; Q=0 forces radial levels to zero and phase/link roots not changing the anchor aperture contribute zero to the chosen observable.
exact_scope.observable_core: Every bounded function of the anchor aperture s_a, including f=s_a and the indicator of j_a=1; these are gauge neutral and anchor-preserving in the declared anchored strip.
exact_scope.projection: The one-step projection retains the patch variables and drops the remote diagonal/new-column variables. For n>=1 the patch incidence and all PAH terms entering an anchor-aperture rate are identical.
exact_scope.generator: For every valid aperture root at a, use c_r=m_r exp(-beta DeltaF/2) with the unchanged PAH aperture mobility and add c_r(f(r x)-f(x)); all other parent roots have zero observable increment.
exact_scope.normalization: The unchanged finite counting-measure Gibbs midpoint rate; no conditional Gibbs average, rate fitting or counterterm.
exact_scope.limit: No cutoff, volume, continuum, physical or observation limit; n is a finite strip/refinement label.

compatibility_target.exact_row_identity: The exact tuple (DeltaF, mobility^2, observable increment) for every valid anchor-aperture root is equal between G_1 and G_2 for every patch state; therefore the generator value agrees for every bounded function of s_a.
compatibility_target.boundary_scope: The n=0 square-to-split boundary remains the explicit R-483 defect and is not erased. The sidecar tests the stationary local patch after that boundary, n>=1.
compatibility_target.cumulative: For the anchor-aperture cylinder, delta_n=0 for every n>=1, so every finite cumulative tail is exactly zero after the first geometric boundary.

acceptance_conditions: The parent PAH-OMC-004 hash matches and its no-parent-mutation firewall remains true.
The direct local energy uses only the PAH aperture onsite, edge stiffness and Wilson face terms with the declared Q=0 inputs.
All four patch apertures and five patch links are enumerated without importing the primary sidecar implementation.
The exact generator-row tuple agrees for every state at levels 1 and 2, and a nonzero n=0 boundary witness remains present.
Primary, non-importing independent, hostile and Lean checks pass.
non_claims: This is a verification sidecar for PAH-OMC-004, not a new physical source or a replacement for PAH-001.
It proves exact generator equality only for the declared anchor-aperture cylinder and the n>=1 local strip patch; it is not a global all-cylinder or volume-uniform theorem.
No physical Pre-A, spacetime, gravity, QFT, Yang--Mills, continuum, mass-gap or TOE conclusion follows.
single_next_question: Can the same explicit generator-row locality be proved for a source-authorized nonzero-Q cylinder family and then upgraded to a uniform interaction estimate?
